The present petition has been filed under Article 226/227 of the Constitution of India for issuance of a writ in the nature of mandamus directing respondents No.2 to 4 to release the amount of compensation of the acquired land of the petitioner, as enhanced by the Reference Court under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, Gurugram, vide order dated 15.01.2020, with certain other prayers made in the petition.
2. Counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw the present petition with liberty to avail the remedy of execution application, but in accordance with law.
3. Dismissed as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty.
